pick.name: Raycast
pick.what: Launcher with clipboard, snippets, window management and extensions
pick.why: Best-polished launcher; standard on macOS, now on Windows
pick.free_limits: Free plan: launcher, extensions, window management, snippets, 3-month clipboard history; allowed in organisations without upgrading. Pro $10/mo or $96/yr adds AI, cloud sync, dictation
pick.install: brew install --cask raycast | winget install raycast (or Microsoft Store)

alts.name: PowerToys
alts.what: Command Palette, Advanced Paste, FancyZones, Text Extractor
alts.why: First-party, one install covers several slots

candidates.name: Raycast
candidates.verdict: pick; best on macOS, newer on Windows

decision: Optional. Raycast is the standard launcher on macOS and ships for Windows; PowerToys is the free Windows suite. On Linux use the desktop's built-in launcher or Ulauncher.

os_notes.macOS: Raycast (free tier plus paid) or Spotlight.
os_notes.Windows: PowerToys (free, MIT) or Raycast for Windows.
os_notes.Linux: No Raycast build; use built-in launcher.

verify.note: Raycast's own page gives 'winget install raycast'; Raycast.Raycast not confirmed.
